question: According to Hebrews 4:2, why was the message the Israelites heard of no value to them?
options: Because it was spoken in another language
Because no one explained it to them
Because they did not share the faith of those who obeyed
Because they heard it too late
explanation: Hebrews 4:2 says the message was of no value to them, because they did not share the faith of those who obeyed.
